newsitem.title: BELGIUM: France wants to end EU calf early marketing scheme.
newsitem.headline: France wants to end EU calf early marketing scheme.

text.p: France has asked EU farm ministers to discuss next week a French memorandum calling for the immediate suspension of an early marketing scheme for calves which it says is ruining the veal market.
The scheme was approved last October as part of a package to reduce beef and veal production so as to bring it into line with lower consumer demand following the mad cow crisis.

"Faced with such a situation, it's no longer possible to extend the early slaughter premium, which at great expense is ruining the veal sector and already disrupting other essential agricultural sectors," the memorandum said.

France warned that if nothing was done quickly to resolve what it called an "absurd and dangerous" situation it would be forced to take emergency action to safeguard its veal industry and make it competitive again.
However EU officials said that some member states, including Italy and Belgium, were reluctant to discuss the issue at short notice.
